priority_tiers.description: Core narrative sources - primary, high-reliability, high-relevance feeds expected to be central to daily narrative detection.
Specialist sources - narrower scope, high relevance within their category, not broad enough to anchor a dominant narrative alone.
Context sources - general business/background sources providing breadth and secondary confirmation.
